    """Distance from outermost edge, going inwards"""

    # Going up from row r: r steps
    # Going down from row r: n-1-r steps
    dist_up = r
    dist_down = n - 1 - r
    dist_left = c
    dist_right = n - 1 - c
    
    # Distance from the closest edge
    return min(dist_up, dist_down, dist_left, dist_right)
